verdict.rationale: Figma's design page claims "best-in-class layout tools" with "full control" and "perfect down to every pixel" precision, which loosely supports the precise-alignment part of the story. Nothing in the pack documents pen tools, path editing or boolean operations. missing for 10: documented pen tool and path/vector editing, boolean operations, specific alignment/snapping documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of vector tooling quality.

support.subject: As a designer, I get professional vector tools — pen and path editing, boolean operations, precise alignment — for real interface design work

citations.quote: With best-in-class layout tools, type tools, and more, you have full control over how you design.
Made for the big picture. Perfect down to every pixel.
